<!-- SOURCE_TURN_001_BEGIN -->
Subject: Friendly Request to Cease and Desist Use of JetSign Name

Dear [Software Company's Name] Team,

I hope this email finds you well. My name is [Your Name], and I represent JetSign, a leading e-signature software company. First and foremost, I would like to congratulate you on your new software. It's always exciting to see innovation and growth in our industry.

However, I am writing to bring to your attention a matter of trademark infringement. It has come to our notice that you have named your software "JetSign," which is identical to the name of our e-signature software. We launched our JetSign software in 2019 and have since established a strong presence in the market with thousands of customers and over 1 million users. Our software is available through <https://www.jetsign.com>, Google Play, and Apple's App Store.

Our JetSign trademark is registered with the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) under classes 9 and 42. You can find the details of our registered trademark here: <https://file.trademarkia.com/search/trademarks?query=jetsign&reset_page=false>.

As a fellow software company, we understand the effort and resources that go into developing and launching new products. We value the spirit of collaboration within our industry and would like to resolve this matter amicably. Therefore, we kindly request that you cease and desist from using the JetSign name for your software to avoid any confusion or infringement of our trademark rights.

We believe that taking this step will not only protect our rights but also ensure that both our companies can continue to grow and thrive in the market without any legal complications. We are confident that your software has the potential to make a significant impact in the industry under a unique and original name.

Please let us know your thoughts on this matter and confirm your commitment to changing the name of your software within the next 14 days. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this regard.

Should you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me directly. We look forward to your prompt and positive response.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
JetSign, [Your Company Name]
[Your Email Address]
[Your Phone Number]
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_001_END -->
